transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. 

Well, I'm mainly here because I had to do a physical for my insurance recently, and the doctor there told me my weight was too low. I mean, to me, I just look lean. I paint houses for a living, so I'm constantly climbing up and down ladders and working really long days. I figure that's just why I'm thin, but they said I needed to come see someone about it.
When you look in the mirror, do you feel that your current weight is appropriate for your body, or do you find yourself feeling like you need to lose more weight?

I guess I don't really see it as needing to lose weight, exactly, but... I do pay a lot of attention to how I look. When I catch myself in a mirror, or if I see a photo of myself standing next to one of my murals, I'm definitely checking myself out. Honestly, I kind of judge my whole day by whether my stomach and my face look sharp enough. If I look too soft, it just bothers me. So I wouldn't say I need to lose weight, I just need to make sure I stay lean.
Do you find yourself intentionally limiting the amount or types of food you eat in order to keep your weight from increasing?

Yeah, I suppose I do. Most days I really just keep it to coffee, and maybe I'll have a protein bar between paint jobs. Then I'll just eat a small dinner at night. 

Eating a full meal during the day... it just feels like it would slow me down and make me sluggish on the ladders. So I keep things pretty limited, which, yeah, I guess also makes sure I don't put on any extra weight or get soft. It just works better for me to keep it light.
Could you tell me your current height and weight?
I'm about 5'10", and the doctor at the physical said I was around 112 pounds.
Aside from limiting your food intake, do you ever engage in behaviors like self-induced vomiting, using laxatives, or excessive exercise specifically to compensate for eating?

No, I don't do any of that. I've never made myself throw up or taken laxatives or anything like that. And as for exercise... I mean, my job is already pretty physical, being up and down ladders and carrying gear all day. So I don't really go out of my way to work out on top of that just to burn off what I eat. I just stick to keeping my food light in the first place.
Have you ever felt that you lose control over your eating, such as eating an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time?
No, I can't say I've ever done that. I don't really ever have moments where I just eat a lot at once or feel like I can't stop. Like I said, I just keep things pretty controlled and light.
Have you noticed any changes in your sex drive or interest in sexual activity since you've been maintaining this weight?
No, not really. I haven't noticed any changes there. I mean, my interest in that kind of stuff seems about the same as it always has been. So, no, I wouldn't say my weight has affected it at all.
Are you currently experiencing regular menstrual periods?
Uh... well, I'm a guy, so, no. I definitely don't get periods. I think you might have mixed something up there.
